info.title: Rolnopol API v1
info.description:
Stable production API for the Rolnopol service.

**Generated** from the live Express router by `npm run schema:generate` — do not edit by hand.

Operations marked with `x-feature-flag` are gated: they answer **404** while their flag is off. Flags are listed at `GET /api/v1/feature-flags` and toggled via `PATCH /api/v1/admin/feature-flags`.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrative plane — requires an admin bearer token.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Registration, login, logout and session token lifecycle.

tags.name: Feature Flags
tags.description: Read and toggle the flags that gate most subsystems below.

tags.name: Platform
tags.description: Endpoints served at `/api` rather than under a version prefix.

403.description: Request did not originate from localhost. The application keeps running.

example.error: Shutdown is available from localhost only

get.description: Gracefully stops the whole application: launched external services, plugins, both WebSocket gateways and the Notification Center are torn down, databases are flushed, then the process exits 0. Available from localhost only — requests from any other address, or carrying a proxy hop header (X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, Forwarded), are refused with 403 and nothing is stopped. Requires no credentials: the network location of the caller is the gate. Under NODE_ENV=test the endpoint reports `data.simulated: true` and skips the teardown so it cannot kill a test run.
